subject: Opportunity age realignment + sprint notice
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Align: Opportunity age realignment + sprint notice

Team — quick one this morning. Finance ran the mid-month forecast hygiene report and a small cluster of opportunities are both aged (>120 days) and still in 'Demo Scheduled' / 'Verifying' stages with open close dates in the next 30–90 days. We need to either requalify, adjust close dates, or mark for archive so the commit picture is accurate for Q2 planning.

Action items (please by EOD Thursday 3/18):
- Own: Reply to this thread with SFDC ID(s) you will own for the sprint.
- Update: Set final close-date or stage to "Deferred/No Commit" if the customer is not actively progressing.
- Evidence: Add a short note in the deal activity (1–2 lines) explaining the next milestone or the reason for deferral.

I attached the opps extract (opps-aging-20270315.csv) — row order is by days open. Top three that need immediate attention: DEAL-7891 (Stellar Health), DEAL-7920 (BluePeak), DEAL-7834 (Rivermark). If you believe a deal is accurately forecasted, just set the true close-date and tag "finance:locked" in the HubSpot deal.

Why this matters: finance will reconcile committed ARR against pipeline on Friday, and any stale or mis-staged opportunities skew our burn and capacity planning. Small administrative asks now avoid huge forecast noise later.

If there are dependency blockers (legal terms, PO lag, security review) call them out in one line — we can escalate rather than let it sit.

Link to filtered SFDC report: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7891
Attachment: opps-aging-20270315.csv

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Thanks Mateo — taking a pass now. Quick status on the top items: 
- DEAL-7891 (Stellar Health): Demo completed 2/2; awaiting PO. Erin Walsh (customer) indicated procurement will be delayed until mid-April. I will update close-date to 2027-04-20 and add note: "Procurement delay; vendor review complete; PO expected mid-April." Will not tag finance:locked.
- DEAL-7920 (BluePeak): Not engaged in 45 days, sales contact unreachable — proposing stage -> "No Commit" and archive.

Question: for DEAL-7834 (Rivermark) I have a brief sync scheduled tomorrow — do you want me to change the close-date post-sync, or should we mark as Deferred now?

Appreciate the nudge. Quick reminders for owners: please set the "commit-status" custom field to one of: Locked / Commit-At-Risk / No-Commit. Finance needs that field to roll up the committed ARR. If you update the close-date but don't set commit-status, it won't be included in the locked forecast.

I'll take DEAL-7920 if Laura is comfortable archiving it — I'll flag for follow-up in two weeks before final archive.
